about_the_game:
The Wall is a cinematic visual novel set in a post-apocalyptic world in which your existence is confined to a futuristic but disturbing city, safeguarded by an immense wall that protects its inhabitants from the horrors that lurk beyond.

However, the city harbors a dark secret, and you are entangled in it. Will you discover the truth behind the wall?

Live the story, make decisions and enjoy the multiple endings in this story of sacrifice and hope.

A complex story

The Wall is more than a science fiction story: it is a horror experience. A unique journey meticulously designed to offer an immersive and captivating adventure.

To achieve this, the game includes cinematic sequences, intense moments, mini-games and narrative twists designed to take your breath away.

What's more, everything is threaded together by an excellent narrative, based on an award-winning short story, full of twists and surprises.

Multiple Endings

The story will take you down multiple paths with different endings depending on your decisions. In addition, the game incorporates M.I.N.D. (Metacognitive Introspection, Narrative Dynamics), the voice inside your head. Throughout your journey, you will have conversations with yourself and your inner voice will react to your actions and decisions. Be cautious with your choices; after all, no one knows you better than you know yourself.

Adult Content

The Wall is intended for an adult audience due to the level of violence, gore and savage depictions of abuse present in the story. It is not your typical happy anime story. Here we have not held back when it comes to showing what the story required. It is a dark tale, about human resilience, freedom and alienation from a society that ignores what is going on in the shadows.

A unique cinematic experience

The Wall has been a project that has waited 25 years to become a reality. Originally conceived as a static adventure with pixelated backgrounds, we have transformed it into a rich audiovisual experience that pushes the boundaries of gaming narrative and immersion.

Hours of video, more than 250 different sequences and several branches to reach the different endings will keep you trapped for hours trying to unravel the mystery behind the wall.

Exclusive Soundtrack

The Wall's soundtrack has 80's techno-pop and synthwave influences, mixed with the personal style of the game's author. A lot of time is being dedicated to create a whole musical ecosystem that brings this particular world of terror and science fiction to life.

Join the resistance and find the secret behind the graffiti you will see all over the city: "THE WALL IS A LIE".

Who we are

Dad and Son Games is an indie development group formed by Victor Vergara, a multidisciplinary artist with 25 years of experience in the audiovisual and videogame industry, and Alex Vergara, his son. Together they started this project when Alex was 12 years old, and together they have been working on it for more than two years in order to offer a unique narrative experience.

content_descriptors.notes: The wall presents disturbing images of graphic violence and gore. Even so, the visual aesthetics of the game were expressly sought to greatly reduce the graphic impact of the images, as they are quite confusing and not very detailed, which makes them much more digestible.
